reviews.comment:
antes el aire era gratis. despues lo empezaron a cobrar con una ficha que, si cargabas combustible, el playero no te la cobraba. ahora lo cobran con qr, realmente un fastidio. uno deja tranquilamente 100 mil pesos por cargar el tanque, podrian tener la delicadeza de obsequiarle un chorrito de aire comprimido o al menos ahorrarle el tedio de tener que sacar el telefono y andar escaneando un coso, las personas grandes se lo agradeceriamos. por favor revisen eso. despues la estacion impecable.

(Translated by Google)
The air used to be free. Then they started charging for it with a token that, if you filled up with fuel, the attendant wouldn't charge you for. Now they charge with a QR code, which is a real nuisance. Someone can easily spend 100,000 pesos to fill up their tank; they could at least have the decency to give a little bit of compressed air or save us the trouble of having to take out our phones and scan something. We older folks would really appreciate it. Please look into that. Otherwise, the station is spotless.

reviews.comment:
El servicio de carga en la estación es muy rápido. En mi caso fui también al lavadero y la verdad bastante conforme. Hice el lavado más premium y quedó bastante bien. No impecable pero bien, obviamente conviene si sos socio, de otra manera es demasiado caro el lavado para lo que ofrece. Hay un pre lavado primero y luego pasas a la parte del interior. Lo que no vi muy presente en el auto fue la super cera (que tiene un costo extra). La próxima estaré más atento a eso.

(Translated by Google)
The charging service at the station is very fast. I also went to the car wash and was quite satisfied. I opted for the premium wash and it came out pretty good. Not spotless, but good. Obviously, it's worth it if you're a member; otherwise, the wash is too expensive for what it offers. There's a pre-wash first, and then you move on to the interior. What I didn't see much of on the car was the super wax (which costs extra). I'll pay more attention to that next time.
